provenance.reference: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-12 Part 12 Ed 2.4 (15 June 2015), §5.2.35 I021/210, bits 6/4; official PDF: https://www.eurocontrol.int/sites/default/files/content/documents/nm/asterix/20150615-asterix-adsbtr-cat021-part12-v2.4.pdf
provenance.method: One synthetic CAT021 record sets I021/210 MOPS version 3, which Ed 2.4 excludes although Ed 2.7 adds it. FSPEC and preceding item bytes are manually constructed from the CAT021 UAP/item layouts; expected typed refusal is authored from the edition rule, not decoder output.
